changelog: 🏥 Modern Healthcare Dashboard Redesign: Clean white & medical-blue aesthetic with Emergency Red exclusively reserved for life-critical SOS triggers

🔟 10 Dedicated Healthcare Cards: Emergency SOS, Medical ID QR, Blood Donor Network, Digital Health Records, Medicine & Visits, AI Assistant, Family Health Circle, Nearby Hospitals & ER, First-Aid & CPR, and Recent Activity Audit

♿ Advanced Accessibility Engine: WCAG AAA High Contrast mode (7:1+ contrast ratio, black/white/yellow), Large Text mode (115% scale with heightened tap targets), universal keyboard focus outlines (focus-visible:ring-4)
🗣️ Web Speech Voice Navigation: Hands-free voice recognition with auditory feedback (Emergency, Blood, Medical ID, Health, Medicines, Hospitals, First Aid, Home)
🏷️ Color-Independent Status Indicators: Every state verified with semantic icons and bracketed textual tags ([TAKEN], [PENDING], [VERIFIED], [URGENT])
🧭 Full 8-Item Navigation: Home, Emergency, Medical ID, Blood Network, Health, AI Assistant, Family, Profile with responsive Desktop Navbar & Mobile BottomNav
🚨 Universal Persistent Quick Emergency Button: Speed dial for 1-tap SOS dispatch, 108 Ambulance, 112 Emergency, Medical ID QR, and CPR Metronome accessible across every screen
🌐 6-Language Support: English, தமிழ் (Tamil), हिंदी (Hindi), తెలుగు (Telugu), ಕನ್ನಡ (Kannada), മലയാളം (Malayalam)
